propositions: CLI command identity and policy are reconstructed through 19 overlapping frozensets, regex-based reference generation, and hand-maintained help resources, causing parser/help drift and inconsistency.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help; `rebar help <command>` reports them unknown while handler-owned `--help` is inconsistent and can execute work.
Runtime parsing and generated syntax/options must derive from a single side-effect-free argparse factory used by both execution and build-time generation, eliminating duplicate grammar authority.
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and runtime-authoritative, read before operation/config/mount/handler resolution, ensuring help stays pre-operation.
Semantic capability registry must map capabilities to packaging extras with postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without eager optional imports.
CLI reference generation, coverage checks, and lean-wheel validation must enumerate registries and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses.
